title: STRIVE project-update draft, version 1
description: A draft an agent prepares for a person. Encode it as base64url JSON in the URL fragment of /?post#project-draft=... The page only fills the form; the person reviews, edits and chooses to save privately. Nothing is saved, published or sent by opening the link. Unknown keys are ignored, so a draft cannot set visibility, audience or metrics.

problem.description: Purpose or context: who needs this and why

changed.description: What it does now, in one or two plain sentences

link.description: Public http or https project link

agent.description: Name shown as the draft's author

evidence.description: Public sources the draft relies on; shown to the person, not saved
